text:
68세 남성 환자, acute exacerbation of chronic heart failure로 입원.  
fluid overload 및 dyspnea 호소함.

BP 150/90 mmHg, HR 110 bpm, RR 24 breaths/min, BT 37.2°C, SpO2 92% (room air).

Dyspnea moderate level 확인됨.  

Furosemide 40 mg IV BID 적용함.

Oxygen support 2L nasal cannula 적용함.

Foley 유지함.  

Positive fluid balance 확인됨.

Clinical status alert 유지함.
